code:

far more than any single request should carry up front.

code:
Full catalog (40 tools)
  -> classify sub-goal -> plausible subset (3-5 tools)
  -> agent sees ONLY that subset in its tools array
  -> selection is now a much easier choice
caption: The same idea as tool search — implemented in your own code.
